text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since her miraculous recovery, the 
name Yukoma Onsen rapidly drew 
attention... and the hot spring town was 
flooded with Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Refreshing, resting, and recovering from 
injuries. Every girl comes here for 
different reasons. Yet in the end, they 
all—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Thank you so much! My ankle's 
totally fine now! I'll give it my all at 
the academy again starting tomorrow~!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... I am glad to hear that. It 
brings me great joy to have been of help.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Truly...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Please come visit us anytime. Next time, 
preferably before you get injured.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Landlady, it's already break 
time, you know? You've been like this all 
the time lately. Aren't you tired?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"You're a hundred years too early to be 
worrying about my health. I take perfect 
care of my own condition."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, my apologies for that.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Landlady. Everyone's leaving with 
a smile on their face, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, everyone's so full of energy. Full of 
energy, and healthy.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
This is the kinda view I always wanted to 
see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? I am truly honored. Yes, we 
can discuss the details later—

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Proprietress, there's a call from the URA. 
They'd like to arrange a facility tour for 
their staff.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, apparently the Yukoma Onsen Resort is 
gaining renewed attention at headquarters 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"Both the visitor count and business 
conditions have recovered, and they're 
even increasing the subsidies♪"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Is that true? In that case, we might not 
have to close down the inn after all!"

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Yes! We did it!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... This is all thanks to 
the Trainers, too."
